writeup: TIC 232087808 is a candidate eclipsing binary star system detected through automated analysis of TESS photometry. The system shows a primary eclipse with a depth of 4.87 percent dimming and repeats every 3.7265 days. A secondary eclipse was also detected at 5.3 sigma significance, located at orbital phase -0.49. The detection achieved a Box Least Squares signal-to-noise ratio of 108.8, and pixel-level difference imaging confirmed the signal with a peak signal-to-noise of 44.1 and a centroid offset of 3.7 arcseconds from the target position. The candidate does not appear in any of six major variable-star catalogs. The machine learning screening score is 0.57, and the candidate passed all data quality checks.
